text: “I should like very much to show it to you,” he added. “Don’t believe him,” cried the old man; “don’t look at it! It’s a wretched old barrack--not to be compared with this.” “I don’t know--I can’t judge,” said the girl, smiling at Lord Warburton. In this discussion Ralph Touchett took no interest whatever; he stood with his hands in his pockets, looking greatly as if he should like to renew his conversation with his new-found cousin. “Are you very fond of dogs?” he enquired by way of beginning.
